name: Party Address 1
definition: Provides various address types of a party.

AnyBIC.name: Any BIC
AnyBIC.definition: Code allocated to a financial or non-financial institution by the ISO 9362 Registration Authority, as described in ISO 9362 "Banking - Banking telecommunication messages - Business identifier code (BIC)".

URLAddress.name: URL Address
URLAddress.definition: Address for the Universal Resource Locator (URL), for example, used over the www (HTTP) service.

PartyAddressRule.definition: At least one message element in the list (AnyBic, PostalAddress, EmailAddress, URLAddress) must be present. More than one message element in the list may be present.
